summary: Component W5 of plan wave-latency-2026-10 (D6). Today only the ship scan reads and writes internal/testverdict (go/internal/phases/ship/scanshadow.go); its shadow found 0 escapes in 1826 results. The build floor and the audit write their package verdicts with the content key of the ship, plus the toolchain, the test flags and the gate id. The store refuses a record with no gate id, and a FAIL is never reused. The ship skips a package with a green verdict on the same key. At shadow the ship looks up, still runs and records each mismatch; enforce after one wave with 0 mismatches. A new verb, evolve verdicts wipe, empties the store. Research F4.1-F4.3, O6, O7.
